tytul: Sweet cherries in amaretto syrup: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for sweet cherries canned in syrup with amaretto (almond liqueur).

ostrzezenia.tekst: Syrup helps keep the flavor, color and shape of the fruit, but it does not prevent spoilage.
The NCHFP recipe for whole cherries lists only water, apple juice, white grape juice or syrup as the liquid and does not mention vanilla or other additions.

akapity: NCHFP has a tested recipe for canning whole sweet or sour cherries in a boiling-water canner.
Amaretto is an addition outside this tested recipe.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for cherries canned in syrup with amaretto from a checked source.
JarAtlas has cards for sweet cherries canned by the tested NCHFP recipe, without alcohol.
